Hi Bettina, I couldn't set up the Monday digest. The scheduler isn't reachable from my session right now: both the list and status calls failed with a gateway credentials error. So nothing is scheduled yet, and I haven't posted anything.

Once scheduling works, I can set it up as you describe: a 'Coastal week ahead' post in #coastal-team at 08:00 every Monday, starting Monday 2026-10-19, covering the previous week in #coastal-team and #coastal-random plus open customer items. Both channels have the same members (you, Kwame, Sofia and me), so the digest won't reach anyone who can't already see those channels. I'd also leave out money terms (rates, prices, contract values, invoice amounts), since those go only to the finance roles and account owners. Seat counts, renewal dates and ticket numbers can stay in.

Someone with gateway access will need to fix the scheduler credentials. Ask me again after that and I'll create the job and run one test post so you can check the format.
